card.name: The In- of inhibition after CYP enzymes
card.fires_on: The first piece "In" of the word inhibition or inhibitors, right after an enzyme name such as CYP3A4 or CYP1A2, or after MAO. Mostly in drug interaction tables.

modes.label: Enzyme in parentheses
modes.description: "In" inside a bracketed enzyme label like (CYP3A4 Inhibition) in an interaction table row.

modes.label: Enzyme inhibitors heading
modes.description: "In" starting inhibitors after an enzyme or MAO in a heading or recommendation.

card.writes: It does not clearly promote the rest of the word; it suppresses inhibit-type completions, so it has little visible effect.
card.plain: It marks the start of the word inhibition or inhibitors written right after an enzyme name in interaction tables.
